column1: # gpu-probe ENV+COLD ladder — the two axes every other table here left untested.
#  upshift  = release the CUDA context, stay silent until the card parks and its
#             PCIe link falls to its idle speed, then bring it back and do ONE
#             kernel. Every death on this fleet happened seconds after exactly
#             that; no other mode reproduces it because they all keep one warm
#             context and one loaded link for their whole life.
#  envtest  = run a probe mode inside ANOTHER UNIT's Environment/User/sandbox,
#             read live from that unit, so a healthy workload meets the same
#             userspace the deployed service gives it.
